result.document_summary: Massachusetts General Laws c. 186 § 12, setting notice requirements to terminate a tenancy at will, including a 14-day notice to quit for nonpayment of rent and a 10-day right to cure.
result.notes: The section governs notice to terminate tenancies at will (three months' notice generally; 14-day notice for nonpayment with a one-time cure right). It does not list allowed eviction causes, relocation assistance, or a just-cause regime. It is a notice-procedure rule and falls outside the six in-scope categories on its own terms. The only arguably related content is the nonpayment notice and cure mechanics, which is a termination-notice rule, not a just-cause regime, so no records were extracted.
